newsitem.title: USA: Quigley denies news report about CFO.
newsitem.headline: Quigley denies news report about CFO.

text.p: Quigley Corp denied on Tuesday a news report that said chief financial officer Eric Kaytes had resigned.
Kaytes has not resigned his positions as director, secretary and chief financial officer, the company said.

"The company is unaware of the source of these false and malicious statements, but they are part of an ongoing effort by unknown parties to discredit this company and its business operations," the company said in a statement.
The company said it has asked regulators to investigate the circumstances around this campaign.
